cues.text: What is searching for bids actually costing you?
Start with your estimator's hourly rate, fully loaded. Say fifty-five dollars.
Hours a week spent reviewing and monitoring bids. Say eight.
That's about two thousand, three hundred and sixty dollars a month, in estimator time alone, before a single bid is written.
Run your own numbers. The Opportunity Waste Calculator is at phildave.com.
